# Justification Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:JustificationStatus`](gmeow-JustificationStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/JustificationStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A value vocabulary for justification-defeat states of a doxastic state or standpoint-claim — solver-set flags such as Gettier-case, defeated, undercut, and rebutted. These are quality values ([gufo:QualityValue](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)) attached via [`gmeow:defeatedBy`](../properties/gmeow-defeatedBy.md); the reasoner never infers them ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:JustificationStatus`](gmeow-JustificationStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary when a solver marks a [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) or [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) with a justification-defeat status.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as a global truth predicate or letting the reasoner promote/derogate statuses; it is a solver annotation only.

### How to use

- Reference one of the seeded individuals from a [`defeatedBy`](../properties/gmeow-defeatedBy.md) link on a [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) or [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md); align undercut/rebutted with the inference slice's Pollock defeater kinds ([`gmeow:defeaterUndercutting`](../individuals/gmeow-defeaterUndercutting.md) / [`gmeow:defeaterRebutting`](../individuals/gmeow-defeaterRebutting.md)).

### Examples

- ex:aliceBelievesRound [`gmeow:defeatedBy`](../properties/gmeow-defeatedBy.md) [`gmeow:justificationStatusGettier`](../individuals/gmeow-justificationStatusGettier.md).
